name: Hajdúsámson (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the town arms of Hajdúsámson: a crowned blue shield with a white bird and a lion, supported by two yellow lions, above a scroll inscribed HAJDÚSÁMSON.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
